candidates.requirement: Exercise the supported pre-parse configuration of a parser with a caller-supplied 16-byte hash salt, including its use by hashing and inheritance by external-entity parsers.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates root and namespace parsers, then ParseOneInput calls XML_SetHashSalt with an unsigned-long SipHash result before XML_Parse. The parent subsequently creates external-entity parsers.
candidates.failure_condition: For any ordinary valid XML input, such as <a/>, the target has no call that supplies 16 entropy bytes. Its legacy setter fixes the high key half to zero. Thus no target call sequence exercises a caller-chosen full-width salt.
candidates.alternative_paths: Automatic generation, including the possible zero-legacy-salt route, chooses a library-generated value; it cannot exercise a caller-supplied 16-byte value. The target's other parser calls use the same ParseOneInput helper, and child parsers inherit the parent's configured key.
